_help.purpose: Pinned reconciled totals for one booking. The auditor (scripts/audit/booking-reconciliation.mjs) diffs these against live `installment_ledger` rows and the cached `bookings` row, failing CI on any drift.
how_to_use: 3. Fill every value in `expected` with the reconciled total (PKR, integers, no commas).

field_glossary.cash_received: Sum of paid_amount across ALL ledger rows (down payment + installments + possession).
field_glossary.total_contract_value: Sum of due_amount across ALL ledger rows. Should match bookings.total_contract_value.
field_glossary.current_overdue_count: Count of installment rows (excluding down payment and possession) with due_date < today AND (due - paid) > 0.
field_glossary.total_overdue_amount: Sum of (due - paid) across the rows counted in current_overdue_count.
field_glossary.installments_paid: Sum of paid_amount where particulars matches /^installment/i.
field_glossary.possession_paid: Sum of paid_amount where particulars matches /possession/i. This is the 'possession_advance' shown in the dashboard.
field_glossary.down_payment_paid: Sum of paid_amount where particulars matches /down payment/i.

validation_rules: All values are integers in PKR (no decimals, no currency symbols, no commas).
